preconditions: Tool throws an exception excluded by retry_on and on_failure is continue or a callable.
explanation: Both sync and async non-retryable branches invoke _handle_failure. With continue/callable this converts excluded errors into ToolMessages instead of surfacing the failure. The merged upstream fix reraises in both branches.
source_claim: Merged upstream PR #38845 plus inspection of the pinned sync/async branches and _handle_failure.
